content: {"like":["Values uplifting, enriching content that fosters constructive dialogue and mutual respect between different faiths or viewpoints.","Prefers authentic, nuanced performances and storytelling that avoid predictability and formulaic plots.","Enjoys detailed, well-researched historical or biographical narratives that are rich in archival material and insightful analysis.","Appreciates subtle, natural storytelling with strong character development and thematic depth.","Seeks content that balances entertainment with ethical or philosophical reflection, avoiding superficial or overly sentimental conclusions."],"dislike":["Dislikes content perceived as biased, disingenuous, or propagandistic, especially when it includes negative portrayals or misinformation.","Finds predictable, formulaic plots, poor pacing, and uneven storytelling frustrating.","Rejects performances that feel wooden, phoning-in, or lacking chemistry and heart.","Avoids content that includes juvenile or mean-spirited banter, unrealistic portrayals, or unsatisfying endings.","Dislikes content that relies on grandiose or overly dramatic elements, or that fails to provide clear answers or resolution."]}
